evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: The top 1% segment/slice must be labeled with 30% or 0.30, or visually equal to 30% of a 100% chart.
The complement segment must be shown as 70%, or the chart must make the 30% top-1% slice leave 70% unambiguously.

evidence.route_note: geometry requires the two marks to share a zero baseline; a truncated axis fails geometry but may still pass by label
evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: The chart or annotation must show both 1% population share and 30% revenue share, or an explicit 30× overrepresentation annotation.

evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: The chart must show top 1% at 30% and rest at 70%, or an annotation of the 40-point gap.
